packageRules.description: The restic BINARY version pinned in roles/backup. Bumps stay manual: restic is what every backup and every restore runs through. It is a github-releases pin, not an image, so no Trivy image scan applies -- the scanctl fs gate covers the repo side. cloudflared, traefik, postgres, portainer and coturn all left this repo by 2026-08-03; their pins live where the host engines read them, in catena-admin.

Infra app images pinned in role defaults (gatus, healthchecks, recovery nginx, clamav). Manual review, and Trivy-gated -- for real this time. This rule claimed a gate for months while nothing scanned them: the image matrix only ever carried the operator-stack four, which have since moved to catena-admin. The matrix in .github/workflows/trivy.yml now resolves these pins where Renovate reads them, so a bump PR to a tag with a known fixable HIGH/CRITICAL fails CI.
Beszel hub + agent stay ONE PR: the agent pin is kept in lockstep with the hub (same upstream release), so splitting them would merge a hub bump without its matching agent.

Keycloak (Phase Two distribution) image pinned in the keycloak role defaults. Manual review like the other infra pins -- a Keycloak major/minor can break SSO + the oauth2-proxy wiring out-of-band; Trivy gates the PR. Restricted to the rolling X.Y.Z tag; the timestamped X.Y.Z.<unixtime> immutable builds are excluded.
